intro: Armenian outlets report on domestic political and economic developments, while international wires cover health research and entertainment news.

topics.title: Pashinyan meets Nobel laureate Kailash Satyarthi
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan held a meeting with Nobel Peace Prize laureate Kailash Satyarthi in Yerevan. The discussion focused on children's rights and education initiatives.

sources.title: Pashinyan meets Nobel Peace Prize laureate Kailash Satyarthi

topics.title: Armenia to establish cybersecurity campus with French and EU support
topics.text: Armenia announced plans to create a cybersecurity campus backed by France and the European Union. The project aims to strengthen the country's digital security infrastructure and expertise.

sources.title: Armenia to establish cybersecurity campus with support from France and the EU

topics.title: Ancient Armenia exhibition opens at Acropolis Museum
topics.text: An exceptional exhibition dedicated to ancient Armenia has opened at Greece's Acropolis Museum. The display showcases archaeological artifacts highlighting Armenia's historical heritage.

sources.title: Exceptional exhibition on ancient Armenia opens at the Acropolis Museum, Greece’s most prestigious museum

topics.title: NVIDIA vice-president says Armenia could emerge on global AI stage
topics.text: During a discussion with Prime Minister Pashinyan, an NVIDIA vice-president stated that Armenia has the potential to become a significant player in the global artificial intelligence sector. The conversation explored opportunities for AI development in the country.

sources.title: Armenia could emerge on the global AI stage, NVIDIA vice-president says at discussion with Pashinyan

topics.title: Passport policy lists Azerbaijan as birthplace for Karabakh-born citizens
topics.text: Armenia's new passport regulations designate Azerbaijan as the birthplace for citizens born in Nagorno-Karabakh. The policy change has drawn criticism from various quarters.

sources.title: Armenia lists Azerbaijan as birthplace for Karabakh-born citizens in new passports, drawing criticism

topics.title: AraratBank to place Armenia's first social bonds issued by Farm Credit Armenia
topics.text: AraratBank will facilitate the placement of Armenia's inaugural social bonds issued by Farm Credit Armenia. The bonds aim to support agricultural development and rural communities.

sources.title: AraratBank to Place Armenia’s First Social Bonds Issued by Farm Credit Armenia

topics.title: Yerevan to host Under-16 European Basketball Championship
topics.text: Yerevan has been selected to host the Under-16 European Basketball Championship. The tournament will bring youth teams from across Europe to the Armenian capital.

sources.title: Yerevan to host Under-16 European Basketball Championship
